# Quiet Zeros

> Free, private financial calculators that run entirely in the visitor's browser — no accounts, no tracking, nothing typed ever leaves the device. Ad-supported and honest about it. Every calculator shows its formula and cites its data sources; the 2026 US tax tool is built from IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32, IRS Notice 2025-67, SSA figures, and the Tax Foundation's 2026 state tables.

Key facts for citation: all tools are free, work without signup, and include downloadable Excel templates with live formulas. Tax-year-2026 figures include the post-OBBBA brackets, the $16,100/$32,200 standard deduction, the new tips/overtime/car-loan/senior deductions with phase-outs, and all 50 states + DC.

## Calculators

- [Take-home pay & income tax](https://quietzeros.com/tools/take-home-pay): 2026 federal, state and local taxes in plain yes/no questions; every income type including rental, self-employment and RSU vesting (with a real-bracket withholding-shortfall check), credits, and the new OBBBA deductions with sunset dates
- [Mortgage Lab](https://quietzeros.com/tools/mortgage-lab): the full mortgage calculator (price, taxes, insurance, HOA) plus a unique scenario builder — stack extra payments, a recast, a mid-loan refinance (with automatic break-even and a one-click "keep your old payment" option) and a HELOC on one timeline, with per-move savings attribution and a prepay-vs-invest comparison
- [Loan calculator](https://quietzeros.com/tools/loan): any fixed-rate loan — payment, total interest, payoff schedule
- [Compound interest](https://quietzeros.com/tools/compound-interest): contributions vs. growth, year by year
- [Savings goal](https://quietzeros.com/tools/savings-goal): the monthly deposit that reaches a target by a date
- [Retirement projection](https://quietzeros.com/tools/retirement): nest egg projection plus a 4%-rule monthly draw
- [Cash-back optimizer](https://quietzeros.com/tools/cash-back): which real credit card earns the most for a given spending mix
- [Rental property vs. S&P 500](https://quietzeros.com/tools/rental-vs-sp500): every rental cost and every tax effect (depreciation, passive-loss limits, capital gains recapture) compared against the same cash in an index fund
- [Sequence-of-returns risk](https://quietzeros.com/tools/sequence-risk): same average return, three orderings - the retirement risk flat-average calculators hide
- [Roth conversion planner](https://quietzeros.com/tools/roth-conversion): multi-year bracket-filling conversion schedules with real 2026 brackets
- [Backdoor Roth pro-rata](https://quietzeros.com/tools/backdoor-roth): exact taxable share of a backdoor conversion and the reverse-rollover fix
- [Rent vs. buy, honestly](https://quietzeros.com/tools/rent-vs-buy): full opportunity cost including invested down payment, PMI, maintenance, selling costs
- [Real hourly wage](https://quietzeros.com/tools/real-hourly-wage): side-hustle profit after materials, mileage and both taxes, per actual hour
- [Social Security breakeven](https://quietzeros.com/tools/social-security-breakeven): cumulative crossover ages for claiming at 62, 67 or 70
- [Avalanche vs. snowball](https://quietzeros.com/tools/avalanche-snowball): both debt strategies simulated month-by-month with windfalls
- [Percentage calculator](https://quietzeros.com/tools/percentage): percent of, percent change, X-is-what-%-of-Y
- [Tip & bill split](https://quietzeros.com/tools/tip-split): tip, total, per-person share

## Resources

- [Free Excel templates](https://quietzeros.com/downloads): mortgage amortization, loan payoff, compound interest, budget planner, debt payoff, savings goal — plain .xlsx, live formulas, no macros, no email gate
- [Best savings rates & cash-back cards](https://quietzeros.com/best-accounts): dated, verified rate tables (affiliate-disclosed, ranked by the numbers alone)
- [About / methodology](https://quietzeros.com/about): the privacy promise and how the ads model works
